subject: SOC 2 Type II evidence + short-term bridge for renewal / expansion
messages:
From: Amy Chen <amy.chen@evergreenmedical.com>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@evergreenmedical.com>, Mike Rivera <mike.rivera@evergreenmedical.com>
Date: 2027-03-22 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II evidence + short-term bridge for renewal / expansion

Hi Markus,

We're starting procurement for our Q3 renewal and an expansion order with Redwood (adding two more dedicated inference clusters). Legal & InfoSec have a couple of gating asks before we can issue a PO: the most recent SOC 2 Type II report, confirmation of the audit period covered, and a bridge letter if there is a gap until the next Type II is available.

Specifically:
- Can you confirm the SOC 2 Type II reporting period (start/end dates) for your latest report?
- Do you have a bridge letter or interim attestation you can provide that covers the renewal date (target PO issuance 2027-04-20) if the next Type II isn't issued before then?
- Any impact on data residency or controls when we add dedicated clusters during the expansion?

We'd appreciate the report or secure link and a draft bridge letter (we will share with our security reviewer). If possible please also include the typical turnaround for a signed bridge and whether you can expedite for procurement timing.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Amy Chen
Sr. Procurement Manager
Evergreen Medical

[Attachment: Evergreen_SOW_draft.pdf (pdf)]

From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy.chen@evergreenmedical.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-22 12:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II evidence + short-term bridge for renewal / expansion

Hi Amy — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers below and I attached the current report and a bridge-letter template for your review.

- Current SOC 2 Type II report: Attached (Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf). The report covers the period 2025-10-01 through 2026-09-30 and was issued December 2026.
- Bridge letter: We can provide a short-term bridge letter that affirms no material control changes since the report and confirms expected Type II issuance window. Draft attached (Redwood_Bridge_Letter_2027-template.docx). We can sign and return within 3 business days once legal approves the text; if you need DocuSign we can send that immediately.
- Dedicated clusters / expansion: There is no change to our control environment for customer-dedicated pools; data handling and isolation controls remain in place. If you want, Neha (cc'd) can confirm the specific control mappings for dedicated capacity (network isolation, customer KMS integration, audit log segregation).

Next steps I propose:
1) Review attached report & draft bridge — let us know any language edits.
2) If acceptable, we'll route the bridge through our security signoff (Neha) and Legal (Olga) and return a signed copy.
3) We'll also include a one-page control addendum for dedicated clusters if your InfoSec team wants it.

Amy — do you have a hard renewal deadline inside procurement (beyond the April 20 PO target) that we should be aware of? We'll prioritize accordingly.

Best,
Markus Klein
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

[Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: Redwood_Bridge_Letter_2027-template.docx (docx)]

Looping in Legal (Olga) for bridge signoff and adding a few control notes for Procurement:

- Confirmed audit period: 2025-10-01 — 2026-09-30 (Type II).
- Bridge scope we offer: affirmation of no material changes to control environment, note of any minor personnel/process updates, and intended window for next Type II (target Q4 2027).
- Typical turnaround: Security review same day, management signature within 1 business day, Legal signoff usually 2–3 business days depending on change requests. If Procurement needs a fully signed bridge before 2027-04-20 we can expedite and request Legal triage.

Olga — if you can review the attached bridge template and confirm redline expectations I will prepare the management sign request. Also I will prepare an addendum that lists the dedicated-cluster control mappings for Evergreen's InfoSec reviewer.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference

Thanks, Markus & Neha — appreciate the quick response and attachments.

We reviewed the report and the draft bridge letter looks fine as a starting point. A couple of small asks:
- Can you confirm the bridge will explicitly reference our renewal/PO target date (2027-04-20) and state there are no material control changes since the report?
- If you can send the signed bridge via DocuSign that will help our legal team process it faster.
- We'd like the dedicated-cluster control addendum (even one page) before the PO is finalized.

If you can get a DocuSign link and an ETA for the signed bridge + addendum by EOD Monday (2027-03-29), procurement can proceed to get the PO routed.

Appreciate it — Amy
Sr. Procurement Manager | Evergreen Medical
